deck: The Lake Como most visitors never see. Tell me which of these sound like you and I’ll build the days around them.

doors.h: Villa del Balbianello, behind the scenes
doors.p: An exclusive tour of the lake’s most famous villa, beyond the rooms everyone else sees.
The lake from a classic wooden boat, with a captain and no schedule but yours. It’s the way Como was meant to be seen.
A tour or lunch at my favorite hotel on the lake, even if you’re not staying there. It’s only 24 rooms, so getting in as a guest is the hard part.

doors.h: Bellagio by boat, for an afternoon
doors.p: I wouldn’t stay in Bellagio, because it’s crowded. But by private boat for an afternoon, it’s lovely, and you leave before the day-trippers do.
A tour around the lake in a classic car, with stops in the villages the ferries skip.
A car from Milan straight to your hotel. Trust me, Como’s roads are stressful, and this is the easiest way to start the trip.
Moving on to the Dolomites or Tuscany? Make the drive the highlight, with a supercar instead of a sedan.
